A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that there are methods for synthesising the results of studies of diagnostic test accuracy, and that these methods are superior to simply averaging the sensitivity and specificity of individual tests.
the use of the bivariate or HSROC model is recommended for the meta-analysis of diagnostic accuracy data, as it takes into account the threshold effect and allows for between-study heterogeneity.
